Employees — Transactions

The Employee Transactions screen displays a complete history of all financial transactions for a specific employee.

This includes all movements in the employee's clearing account, such as payslips issued, expense claims submitted, and any other employee-related financial entries.

Transactions are listed in chronological order with the most recent entries appearing first. Each transaction shows the date, description, debit and credit amounts, and the running balance.

The balance shown represents the amount owed to or by the employee at any point in time. A positive balance indicates the business owes money to the employee, while a negative balance indicates the employee owes money to the business.

For more information, see: Employee — Edit
